question: debrid/dailyuploads $.limits[3].value currently reads '4 GB per file free, 80 GB per file premium', while the first-party premium table states 'Max download file size | 2 GB | 4 GB | 80 GB' (2 GB free, 4 GB registered, 80 GB premium). Should $.limits[3].value be corrected to the tiered figure, given the record's per_object_cap.stated field already states the 2/4/80 GB download caps?
why: The record is measured and the correction is a documented page read, which cannot override it without lowering the record's rung. No probe measures a per-file download cap, so no measured-rung set is possible. The page row is appended as evidence; settling this needs a hand change in an own clone or a probe at measured rung.
